request_type: Event: J70 Corinthian World Championship Race Number: 6
procedural_matters: The technical committee was represented by Thomas Loesch.
SUI 1132 was represented by Philip Kleisner.
The technical committee presented a Manufacturer’s Declaration dated 8 June 2025, and the SUI 1132’s Class Rules Compliance Form.
SUI 1132 presented a Manufacturer’s Declaration dated 1 September 2022, and a Weight & Equipment Form.
facts: On 29 May 2026, during the post-race inspection, SUI 1132 did not provide a copy of the boat’s current and valid Manufacturer’s Declaration (in paper form or electronic), but she provided her Weight & Equipment Form instead.

During the hearing, the technical committee provided the current Manufacturer’s Declaration of the international class association dated 8 June 2025 which mentions a different owner than the current one.
conclusions: Since the owner has changed, the current Manufacturer’s Declaration on file with the International J/70 Class Association is invalid, according to class rule A.11.1(a).
By not having a valid Manufacturer's Declaration on file with the International J/70 Class Association, SUI 1132 broke class rule B.1.1(b).
By not carrying the boat’s current and valid Manufacturer’s Declaration (in paper form or electronic), SUI 1132 broke class rule C.5.2(a)(10).
By not maintaining her boat to comply with her class rules, SUI 1132 broke RRS 78.1.
Under SI 14.8, the penalty for this breach shall not be less than a ten percent (10%) scoring penalty.
decision: Using the World Sailing Discretionary Penalty Guidelines for Boats & Support Persons, a starting penalty of 5% was decided. There were no facts to justify decreasing or increasing the penalty. However, the penalty is increased to 10% in accordance with SI 14.8. The penalty given to SUI 1132 is a 10% discretionary penalty, calculated using the method described in RRS 44.3(c) and applied to race 6, but not worse than the score for DNF.
